name: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk
summary: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk provides various banking products and services to individuals and businesses in Indonesia, Singapore, Malaysia, Hong Kong, Timor Leste, Shanghai, England, and the Cayman Islands. It offers savings and current accounts, multicurrency, payroll, NOW, and foreign currency savings accounts; personal, mortgage, micro enterprise, small and medium enterprises, working capital, and investment loans; corporate, credit, and debit cards; and e-banking services.
